sql: SELECT TOP 10 ps.ParentZnodeProductId AS productId, MIN(ps.ParentName) AS productName FROM cso.ProductSearch ps INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId = ps.ZnodeCatalogId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = pc.PortalId WHERE po.StoreCode = @store AND ps.IsActive = @isActive AND ps.ParentZnodeProductId IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT x.Id FROM cso.ProductSearch xs INNER JOIN cso.TblCustom_Allocations x ON x.ChildSKU = xs.SKU INNER JOIN cso.TblCustom_UserManagement xm ON xm.UserName = x.SalesRepEmail WHERE xs.ParentZnodeProductId = ps.ParentZnodeProductId AND x.Status = @allocationStatus AND (@owner IS NULL OR xm.Id = @owner)) GROUP BY ps.ParentZnodeProductId ORDER BY ps.ParentZnodeProductId
